Our story

Local, licensed, and honest about the ground we build on.

Campbelltown Landscapers is run by Kay, who has spent 10+ years landscaping across the Macarthur region. That's long enough to know which streets sit on the worst clay, which blocks back onto bush, and what actually lasts out here.

We started with a simple idea: most crews only do one slice of the job, so homeowners end up juggling four half-jobs and four different prices. We do the lot — design, paving, retaining walls, turf, gardens and ongoing care — with one local team, so your yard is planned and built as a single project with the levels and drainage working together.

We're a licensed contractor (353-827-C), we quote fixed prices, and we turn up when we say we will. Coming out to look at your job is free, every time. The number we quote is the number you pay.
